The '''NA LCS 2017 Summer Split''' was the tenth split of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] (NA LCS), organized by Riot Games. It ran from June 2 to September 3, 2017, with the Regular Season held in Los Angeles, United States, and the Playoffs hosted in Boston, United States. The split featured ten teams competing in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}} Group Stage, followed by a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD.

The top teams from the Playoffs qualified for the [[World Championship/2017|2017 World Championship]], while the bottom two teams were relegated to the [[LCS/North_America/2018/Spring/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]]. This was the final NA LCS split before the league transitioned to a franchised system in 2018.
